_doc: Description exacte de chaque élément du produit, ajoutée aux prompts quand sa référence est jointe : Gemini ne doit rien réinventer. Chaque référence est une image nette du produit seul ou en usage, sans texte ni montage.
produit-devidoir: A spool of black thread with RED plastic end caps on both ends, held by an open-frame unwinder made of light birch plywood (two flat side uprights, horizontal rails, a wooden axle through the spool, visible laser-cut edges). IMPORTANT, how it is used: the unwinder never stands on a table; its two slotted legs straddle the TOP EDGE of the open kraft box and the white board inside it, so the spool sits above the top of the board and the thread runs down to the nails.
produit-boite: A flat square kraft cardboard box with a thin black-line string art pattern and the script word 'Deekra' on the lid; it folds open into an inclined stand that holds the board.
produit-boite-ouverte: The large flat kraft cardboard box opened, revealing the WHITE square board with brass nails inside.
produit-planche: A WHITE SQUARE board (50 x 50 cm) with brass nails forming a perfect circle near the edges, small sector letters A, B, C, D in the corners.
produit-planche-montee: The WHITE SQUARE board with brass nails in a circle, held upright by the kraft box stand, the thread spool with red caps on its birch unwinder mounted on top of the board, a smartphone on a small birch stand beside it.
produit-chevalet: A light birch plywood easel: two tall A-shaped triangular legs with a small ledge at the bottom, clean laser-cut edges.
produit-support-telephone: A smartphone on a small light birch phone stand next to the WHITE board with brass nails; the phone shows a white app screen with a circular progress indicator.
planche: The board is always a WHITE SQUARE board (50 x 50 cm) with brass nails forming a perfect circle; never a raw wooden or round board. When in use it sits inside the open kraft box, which stands upright, slightly inclined backwards, propped by a folded cardboard flap behind it; the thread unwinder straddles the top edge of the box and board; a phone on its birch stand sits in front, at the bottom.
